### Open to Change
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-january-30-2021.html
Passage: Jeremiah 22:21
Points:
- Lifelong habit patterns make sinful attitudes feel natural and easy to rationalize with excuses.
- Jeremiah 22:21 reveals how comfortable circumstances and stubbornness foster a refusal to listen to God.
- Habitual sin creates an internal resistance that strongly opposes necessary personal change.
- Believers must look honestly into God's Word to identify where life adjustments are needed.
- In Christ, believers are given a new nature and the daily power to overcome old habits.
